# Input The `Input` component is a comprehensive form control that provides users with a text input field. It includes support for various states, validation, accessibility features, and customization options. Built with React Aria for maximum accessibility compliance. ## Installation Ensure that you have the @zyxui library installed in your project: ```bash npm install @zyxui/input ``` If you haven't installed and setup @zyxui before, please follow the [`installation guide`](/docs/installation) ## Basic Input To create a basic input, simply use the Input component with a placeholder. It will inherit the default styling. ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; export const BasicInputExample = () => { return ( ) } ``` ## Customization The `Input` component is **highly customizable**, allowing you to fine-tune its appearance and behavior to align with your project's unique requirements. Explore the following customization options: ### With Label Add a label to your input for better accessibility and user experience. ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; export const LabeledInputExample = () => { return ( <> ) } ``` ### Variants Modify `Input` styles effortlessly using the `variant` prop, with options like `default`, `filled`, `underlined`, and `bordered`. ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; export const InputVariantsExample = () => { return ( <> ) } ``` ### Sizes Resize your `inputs` effortlessly with the size prop. Choose from `sm` (Small), `md` (Medium), or `lg` (Large) to control the input dimensions. ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; export const InputSizesExample = () => { return ( <> ) } ``` ### States Display different states for validation feedback using the `state` prop and `errorMessage`. ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; export const InputStatesExample = () => { return ( <> ) } ``` ### Start Content The `startContent` prop allows you to add icons or other elements at the beginning of the input field. } label="Username" placeholder="Enter username" /> } label="Email" placeholder="Enter email" type="email" /> } label="Search" placeholder="Search..." /> ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; import { UserIcon, MailIcon, SearchIcon } from 'lucide-react'; export const InputStartContentExample = () => { return ( <> } label="Username" placeholder="Enter username" /> } label="Email" placeholder="Enter email" type="email" /> } label="Search" placeholder="Search..." /> ) } ``` ### End Content The `endContent` prop allows you to add elements at the end of the input field, such as action buttons or status indicators. } label="Password" type="password" placeholder="Enter password" /> @domain.com} label="Email" placeholder="username" /> ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; import { EyeIcon } from 'lucide-react'; export const InputEndContentExample = () => { return ( <> } label="Password" type="password" placeholder="Enter password" /> @domain.com} label="Email" placeholder="username" /> ) } ``` ### Clearable Enable the clearable functionality to allow users to quickly clear the input value. } label="Search" placeholder="Search..." /> ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; import { SearchIcon } from 'lucide-react'; export const ClearableInputExample = () => { return ( <> } label="Search" placeholder="Search..." /> ) } ``` ### Required Fields Mark fields as required for better form validation and user guidance. ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; export const RequiredInputExample = () => { return ( <> ) } ``` ### Disabled State Show disabled inputs for read-only or inactive form fields. ```jsx showLineNumbers import Input from '@zyxui/input'; export const DisabledInputExample = () => { return ( <> ) } ``` ## Advanced Usage ### Form Integration The Input component works seamlessly with form libraries and includes built-in validation support.

| Placeholder text | | `variant` | `'default' \| 'filled' \| 'underlined' \| 'bordered'` | `'default'` | Input style variant | | `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg'` | `'md'` | Input size | | `state` | `'default' \| 'error' \| 'success' \| 'warning'` | `'default'` | Input state for validation | | `radius` | `'none' \| 'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'full'` | `'md'` | Border radius | | `startContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content to display at the start of the input | | `endContent` | `ReactNode` | - | Content to display at the end of the input | | `helperText` | `string` | - | Helper text below the input | | `errorMessage` | `string` | - | Error message (overrides helperText) | | `required` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the field is required | | `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether the input is disabled | | `clearable` | `boolean` | `false` | Whether to show a clear button | | `onClear` | `() => void` | - | Callback when clear button is clicked | | `className` | `string` | - | Additional CSS classes for the input | | `containerClassName` | `string` | - | Additional CSS classes for the container | | `labelClassName` | `string` | - | Additional CSS classes for the label | The Input component also accepts all standard HTML input attributes through React Aria's `AriaTextFieldOptions`. ## Accessibility The Input component is built with accessibility in mind: - ✅ **Keyboard Navigation**: Full keyboard support for all interactions - ✅ **Screen Reader Support**: Proper ARIA labels and descriptions - ✅ **Focus Management**: Clear focus indicators and logical tab order - ✅ **Error Handling**: Accessible error messages and validation states - ✅ **Required Fields**: Clear indication of required fields ## Best Practices 1. **Always provide labels** for better accessibility 2. **Use appropriate input types** (email, password, etc.) 3. **Provide helpful error messages** that guide users to fix issues 4. **Use helper text** to clarify input expectations 5. **Group related inputs** logically in forms 6. **Test with keyboard navigation** and screen readers

import { UserIcon, MailIcon, LockIcon } from 'lucide-react';

export const FormIntegrationExample = () => {
  return (
    <form className="w-full space-y-4">
      <Input
        required
        label="Full Name"
        placeholder="Enter your full name"
        startContent={<UserIcon size={16} />}
      />
      <Input
        required
        type="email"
        label="Email Address"
        placeholder="Enter your email"
        startContent={<MailIcon size={16} />}
        helperText="We'll use this for important notifications"
      />
      <Input
        required
        type="password"
        label="Password"
        placeholder="Create a password"
        startContent={<LockIcon size={16} />}
        helperText="Must be at least 8 characters"
      />
    </form>
  )
}

        required
        label="Full Name"
        placeholder="Enter your full name"

        helperText="Must be at least 8 characters"
      />
    </form>
  )
